corrections.text: The article says that no cited source includes a statement from 'the Python Steering Committee' about the bans mentioned in the thread. 'Python Steering Committee' is the wording of the commenter Steve Holden; the forum labels the project's governing body the Steering Council, and three participants shown as Steering Council members (Pablo Galindo Salgado, Thomas Wouters and Barry Warsaw) posted tributes in the thread. None of those tributes mentions a ban, and no statement by the Steering Council as a body, the Python Software Foundation or the forum moderators about the bans appears in the thread, LWN or PEP 20.
